sources.title: Microsoft: MAI DS R1 (free) AI Model
sources.snippet: Microsoft's MAI DS R1 is a free AI model released on April 21, 2025. It builds on the DeepSeek-R1 foundation, integrating 110k examples from the Tulu-3 SFT dataset and 350k multilingual safety-alignment samples.

sources.title: Self-Host and Fine-Tune Microsoft MAI Models on GPU Cloud: The 9-Model ...
sources.snippet: The practical implication: if you need full inference control, on-premises deployment, data residency compliance, or fine-tuning capability, MAI-DS-R1 is the only model in the family that delivers it.
